[D7:11] John: Thanks, James. Yeah, been super busy at work. Deadlines all over the place and so much to do. It's just been really hectic lately.

Session date: 5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022
[D11:19] John: Thanks, James! Appreciate it. Take care and talk soon!
Session date: 7:33 pm on 23 May, 2022
[D12:1] James: Hey John, last weekend I had an awesome time at the amusement park with my friends. It was a great break from the virtual world. I went on some awesome roller coasters and it reminded me of when I was a kid. Everything was so real and exciting; it felt like I was in a video game!
[D12:2] John: Hey James! Sounds like an awesome time! I bet those rides brought back some great memories. Were there any other attractions besides the roller coaster?
[D12:3] James: Of course, I also managed to ride the Ferris wheel, electric cars and buggies. What's new with you?
[D12:4] John: That's really cool! Last Friday I entered a local tournament and took second place! It was a wild experience and the competitive energy was insane.
[D12:5] James: Wow, John that's awesome! Congrats on your achievement! I can imagine the rush you must have felt during the tournament. Did you receive any rewards or prizes for your success?
[D12:6] John: I was stoked about my achievement. Though I didn't win the tournament, I still received some money for the 2nd place. Seeing my effort pay off was awesome.
[D12:7] James: Awesome news! You don't have to win every time, growth and progress are most important. 
[D12:8] John: Yeah, I also got this trophy! So satisfying. It reminds me to always put in my best effort. What about you? Any success stories lately?
[D12:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a graduation cap on a book with a rope
[D12:9] James: Congrats on your achievement, John! That trophy looks awesome. Last month, I had a personal milestone. There were definitely tough times, but it reminds me of all the hard work. I feel a huge sense of accomplishment and I'm ready for the future opportunities!
[D12:10] John: Congrats on the milestone. What was it and what made it challenging? What did you learn?
[D12:11] James: I finished a big project I had been working on for months. It was challenging because I had to learn a new language and handle many details. I learned a lot about problem-solving, patience, and perseverance. Now I feel more confident to take on even bigger projects.
[D12:12] John:  That's awesome you learned a language and handled all those details. Great job, you definitely picked up some great skills! Remember, determination and confidence make any project a success. Good work!
[D12:13] James: Thanks, I appreciate your support. I'll definitely keep that in mind.
[D12:14] John: No worries, I'm here to help. Keep going and reach those goals!
Session date: 4:30 pm on 13 June, 2022
[D13:1] John: Hey James, long time no talk! A lot has happened during this time. Let me fill you in.
[D13:2] James: Hey John! Awesome to hear from you. Yeah, a lot has happened. Let's catch up!
[D13:3] John: I finally got my dream job! After lots of interviews and late nights, I got the offer and was ecstatic. Can't wait to start my journey!
[D13:4] James: Wow, John! Congrats on getting your dream job. I'm super stoked for you. When do you start?
[D13:5] John: Thank you! ! I'm starting next month.
[D13:6] James: It can be rough getting started, but I'm sure you'll do great. Don't be afraid to seek help if you need it. Can't wait to hear about your experience! By the way, I recently started a course that combines my passion for gaming and programming. It's fun and challenging, and it has definitely increased my excitement for both.
[D13:7] John: Cool! That sounds awesome. Combining your love of gaming and coding sounds like a dream. Tell me more! Are there any interesting projects you're working on?
[D13:8] James: Yes, we are currently working on a new part of the football simulator. I was working on collecting player databases. It wasn't easy, but I did it!
[D13:9] John: Cool! Did you choose this course because you love football?
[D13:10] James: Not least because of this. I love football, but, of course, the most important reason is to improve yourself. But it’s nice if it’s also connected with something you like.
[D13:11] John: I completely agree! By the way, did you watch the Liverpool vs Chelsea match?
[D13:12] James: Of course, they played well! As I like to say, there is no sport better than football, no club better than Liverpool! I don't miss a single match of theirs!
[D13:13] John: It looks like you really root for this team!
[D13:14] James: Absolutely! They are forever in my heart, they are a great team. I hope they become champions next season!
[D13:15] John: As a Manchester City fan, I can't agree with you. You'll see, our two teams will fight for the championship, and mine will win!
[D13:16] James: I'm sure you're wrong, John. Manchester City are in bad form and their transfer policy is terrible!
[D13:17] John: You may be right, but the City manager can handle it, you'll see!
[D13:18] James: I bet we'll be higher than you in the final standings!
[D13:19] John: I'll take the bet, James! This will be a great battle!
[D13:20] James: Sure, John!
Session date: 5:07 pm on 16 June, 2022
[D14:1] James: Hey John, how's it going? A lot has happened for me lately, some good and some not so great. I`m lucky to have at least two people who always help me out when I'm struggling. What about you?
[D14:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying on a person on a couch
[D14:2] John: Gad to hear you have your support system ready. It's crucial, especially during hard times. For me, it's been quite an emotional rollercoaster. Last week, I started my blog about coding. It's exciting and kinda scary too. This is the first picture I uploaded there.
[D14:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen with a program on it
[D14:3] James: Wow, starting a blog about coding is awesome! Must be so exciting. What do you think about it?
[D14:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game scene of a man and woman
[D14:4] John: Thanks, James! It has been an awesome and challenging experience. I'm loving sharing my coding journey with others and tracking everything. It's a great way to connect with other coders.
[D14:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen showing a number of items
[D14:5] James: Congrats on your coding journey! What`s more new in your world?
[D14:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a vase with a plaque on it
[D14:6] John: Well, I bought a lot of new books, and now my bookcase is almost completely filled!
[D14:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bookshelf with a lot of books on it
[D14:7] James: What genre do you enjoy reading?
[D14:8] John: I'm a big fan of sci-fi and fantasy books. Epic fantasy series with immersive world-building and intricate storylines are what I enjoy reading. Just getting lost in the pages of a great story is a wonderful escape from reality.
[D14:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book shelf with a few books on it
[D14:9] James: Cool! Are there any book series that you love and would recommend to others?
[D14:10] John: Definitely! Two of my favorites are "The Stormlight Archive" and "Kingkiller Chronicle". If SF is your thing, check out "The Expanse" series. It's epic!
[D14:11] James: Thanks for the recommendations, John! I'll definitely check out those books. What makes them your favorites?
[D14:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cd with a picture of a knight on it
